description: How consumers, local merchants, and independent couriers relate to each other: who orders from whom, who hands off and delivers, how money and tips settle, and which rating loops keep the three-sided marketplace trusted.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Placing orders and converting local demand into merchant sales

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Preparing, handing off, and delivering orders on time

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Order payments, fees, and courier tips settled through the platform

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Menus, availability, ratings, and delivery-experience feedback

relations.name: Places orders with local merchants
relations.description: Browses nearby restaurants, grocery, and retail options and converts immediate needs into orders with a clear basket, total cost, and promised delivery time.

relations.name: Publishes menus, prices, and availability
relations.description: Keeps menus, item availability, prices, and preparation times accurate on the marketplace so consumers order what the store can actually fulfil right now.

relations.name: Hands off prepared orders
relations.description: Prepares and packs the order and hands it to the assigned courier at pickup, with order-ready timing that decides whether the courier waits or the food goes cold.

relations.name: Coordinates pickup timing
relations.description: Shares arrival estimates and confirms pickup at the counter so preparation and courier arrival line up instead of stacking wait time at the store.

relations.name: Delivers orders to the door
relations.description: Carries the order from store to door within the promised window, following drop-off instructions and confirming delivery with proof in the app.

relations.name: Pays the order total
relations.description: Pays the basket, delivery fee, and service fee at checkout; the platform remits the merchant's share net of commission on the settlement cycle.

relations.name: Tips the courier
relations.description: Adds tips at checkout or after delivery that flow to the courier on top of the per-delivery payout, directly shaping courier earnings per hour.

relations.name: Rates merchants and order accuracy
relations.description: Rates the store and flags missing or wrong items, feeding merchant quality scores that drive ranking, refund liability, and remediation.

relations.name: Rates the delivery experience
relations.description: Rates timeliness and handling of the delivery, feeding courier quality signals used for offer prioritization and fair issue resolution.
